title: York MP calls on royal family to explain source of £12m Virginia Giuffre payment
summary: Rachael Maskell says ‘a lot of clarity’ needed over how Prince Andrew funded settlement of sexual abuse case Why Prince Andrew is giving up his titles now – and what it means for the royal family An MP has called on the royal family to explain how Prince Andrew funded a settlement in a sexual abuse case brought by Virginia Giuffre. Rachael Maskell, who represents York Central, said “a lot of clarity” was needed regarding the reported £12m payment, made in 2022. Continue reading...
